jobs.title: Machine Learning Systems Administrator / DevOps Engineer: Training Clusters & Inference Cloud
jobs.description:
**The Role:**

As a Machine Learning Systems Administrator / DevOps Engineer, you will maintain and build the core infrastructure behind both our model training and our inference cloud. You’ll split your time between our large-scale training clusters and the deployments and services that run our models in production on heterogeneous compute, which spans multiple accelerator types and vendors. You’ll work closely with our training, inference, and product teams to keep these systems reliable, secure, and fast. You’ll also lay the groundwork for workflows that can scale with us.

**You’ll Work Across:**

*Training clusters*

* Administration and automation of our Linux-based cluster environments
* User onboarding/offboarding, access control, and security auditing
* Monitoring system resources, job scheduling, and cluster health
* Bring-up and validation of new hardware (compute, networking, storage)
* Supporting and improving developer workflows (e.g., VSCode remote development, Docker)
* Enabling and supporting large-scale training jobs

*Inference cloud*

* Deploying, operating, and scaling inference services across heterogeneous accelerators
* Managing container orchestration, CI/CD, and rollout pipelines for model deployments
* Building observability for production services, including metrics, logging, alerting, and dashboards
* Owning service reliability: uptime, incident response, and postmortems
* Capacity planning, autoscaling, and utilization/cost tracking across hardware types
* Securing production systems through secrets management, network policy, and tenant isolation

You’ll own critical systems end to end. Your work will directly affect developer productivity, training throughput, and the performance and reliability of our inference platform.

**What We’re Looking For / Requirements:**

* Experience with Linux system administration, user and access management, and automation
* Demonstrated expertise in scripting languages for system tooling and automation (bash, Python, etc.)
* Experience with containers (Docker) and scheduling/orchestration systems (Slurm, Kubernetes)
* Experience running production services, including monitoring and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana), deployment pipelines, and incident response
* Experience building tooling for cluster validation and reliability (accelerator, networking, and storage health checks)
* Experience setting up and managing developer tools and third-party services (e.g., cloud storage providers, Docker Hub, Slack, Gmail, Telegraf, experiment trackers)
* Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills across compute, storage, and networking
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams

**Qualifications / Additional Skills:**

* Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Ansible, Terraform)
* Prior work supporting ML/AI infrastructure, including GPU management and workload optimization
* Experience deploying and operating LLM serving stacks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, Ray)
* Experience with multiple accelerator platforms (e.g., NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, TPUs)
* Experience with high-performance networking (InfiniBand, RoCE) and distributed storage
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Familiarity with Apptainer and with integrating containers into Slurm and Kubernetes

**Why Work at Zyphra:**

* Our research methodology is grounded in methodical, step-by-step approaches to ambitious goals. Both deep research and engineering excellence are equally valued
* We strongly value new and crazy ideas and are very willing to bet big on new ideas
* We move as quickly as we can; we aim to minimize the bar to impact as low as possible
* We all enjoy what we do and love discussing AI

**Benefits and Perks:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and FSA plans
* Competitive compensation and 401(k) plan
* Relocation and immigration support on a case-by-case basis
* In-office snacks and meals provided
* Unlimited PTO and company holidays
* In-person team in San Francisco with a collaborative, high-energy environment

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Ads
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Ads runs one of the largest real-time decision systems in the world. To meet advertiser goals, we process >4 million ad requests per second, and this team decides which of them are worth the compute. We mine a petabyte-scale stream of traffic to tell in-demand, valuable requests apart from wasteful ones, filtering out the noise and forwarding only what brings value to advertisers, all within milli-seconds. Our solutions save millions in compute costs and drive long-term growth for Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses.  
  
Why you'll love this role: The scientific challenge here is scale and signal: large-scale ML on enormous, high-velocity data, optimization and auction dynamics, and causal measurement of what actually moves the business. Generative AI and LLMs are tools you reach for when they help, not the point of the work. The impact also reaches beyond Amazon: we donated the Dynamic Traffic Engine (DTE) to the IAB Tech Lab as an open-source framework that lets demand-side platforms signal which bid requests they value, so supply-side platforms send fewer wasteful ones and QPS waste drops across the whole programmatic supply chain. We are a highly motivated, collaborative team with an entrepreneurial spirit and a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. You will work alongside talented engineers, product managers, and scientists in a culture that rewards bias for action, innovation, and experimentation. What makes this role unique is the combination of scientific rigor with real-world impact at a scale very few systems reach.  
  
Your impact and career growth: Amazon Ads is investing heavily in AI and ML, creating room for scientists to innovate and make their mark. As an Applied Scientist, you will own the science for well-defined supply-optimization problems and take your work end to end, from framing the approach through experimentation and into production with measured business impact. You will partner closely with engineers to productionize your models and with product managers to tie your science to customer and advertiser outcomes. You will share your findings, begin to mentor teammates, and grow your influence on the team's technical direction over time. This is your opportunity to do high-rigor applied science in one of the fastest-growing businesses at Amazon.  
  
Learn more about Amazon Ads: https://advertising.amazon.com/
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As an Applied Scientist in Amazon Ads, you will:  
  

* Conduct hands-on data analysis and build large-scale ML models and pipelines for supply optimization.
* Take your models end to end, from proof of concept through experimentation, optimization, and deployment into production, working closely with software engineers to productionize them and with product managers and fellow scientists along the way.
* Design and run A/B experiments and causal analysis to validate hypotheses, draw insights from petabyte-scale data, and measure real business impact.
* Research and apply advanced ML, including generative AI and large language models, to demand prediction and traffic filtering.
* Drive end-to-end optimization projects that tackle ambiguous problems at massive scale, developing scalable, efficient processes for model development, validation, and deployment that optimize traffic monetization while maintaining customer experience.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

**About Watershed**
-------------------

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

**The role**
------------

Watershed’s Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the foundational systems that power our product and help every engineer ship safely and efficiently. We own core compute, databases, networking, deployments, and observability, with a focus on production reliability, predictable infrastructure costs, security, and a low-toil developer experience.

Our work spans both operational excellence and high-leverage platform improvements. Current areas of investment include: upgrading our networking architecture, improving the usability of test environments and deployment systems, evolving our observability toolkit, hardening Watershed’s AI infrastructure as our AI product suite grows, and supporting agentic engineering workflows.

**You will**
------------

* Design, build, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure that powers all of Watershed (across compute, databases, networking, deployment systems, and observability)
* Contribute to technical planning, design reviews, team processes, and a culture of thoughtful, high-impact development
* Collaborate with product engineers (our internal customers) to understand their needs and provide high-leverage infrastructure primitives that help them move faster, safely
* Strengthen Watershed’s cloud security in partnership with our Security and Compliance functions, and drive infrastructure cost efficiency in collaboration with our Finance team
* Participate in the team’s 24/7 on-call rotation and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements

**You might be a good fit if**
------------------------------

* You have 2–5 years of software and/or infrastructure engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience
* You have hands-on experience in some of these areas: Kubernetes, Terraform / infrastructure as code, CI/CD, networking, relational databases, observability, reliability, or cloud security. Experience with a major cloud provider is a must; experience with GCP is helpful, but not required
* You enjoy the challenge of building the appropriate level of tooling for the stage and arc of the company, in particular being on the front lines of supporting AI infrastructure and agentic products
* You enjoy building enabling systems that help other engineers deliver excellent customer outcomes

**Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)**

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

**What’s the interview process like?**

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

**What if I need accommodations for my interview?**

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

### **Job Summary**

Our Internal Acceleration team’s mandate is to build agents to accelerate the production of frontier tokens.

You’ll work directly with our founders and embed with our hardware team to build new agentic harnesses and operating systems to transform the way hardware is built in an AI native world. You’ll work on harnesses, tool use, context, and memory, execution environments, and evals that let agents conduct long-running engineering work that is useful.

This role is for engineers who thrive on ambiguity, have real product sense, and want to own problems end to end. It’s a whiteboard for future founders. The problems we solve are time-sensitive and business-critical. This role will not be a 9-5, and the ideal candidate is excited about that.

### **You may be a good fit if you**

* Have at least 1-5+ years of experience building and shipping software end to end, ideally at a fast-moving startup
* Have built agents for complex, multi-step tasks that people depend on, beyond calling an API: tool design, long-context management, evals, and failure analysis.
* Are a strong software engineer who has built reliable systems others depend on, such as distributed systems, experiment infrastructure, or developer tooling.
* Use coding agents heavily, read their transcripts closely, and change the system when an agent is confidently wrong.
* Have high agency in unfamiliar domains. You find the real problem and drive it forward.
* Have product sense, design taste, and extreme attention to detail

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Embed with our hardware team to find the highest-leverage bottlenecks, and own each one from first idea to a tool engineers rely on every day.
* Build and deploy LLM agents wired into our engineering workflows via tool-calling and MCP.
* Build execution environments where agents can verify their own work, with sandboxed access to simulators, EDA flows, compilers, profilers, and real hardware.
* Ship full-stack internal products from zero to one: the interfaces, data pipelines, and infrastructure that define how Etched builds.
* Measure what works. Design evals and track adoption so we double down on the tools that matter and kill the ones that don’t.
* Take on special projects directly with the founders, surfacing problems across the company and doing whatever it takes to hit critical milestones.

### **Strong candidates may also have**

* Exposure to chip development, kernels, hardware, or manufacturing.
* Infrastructure, data engineering, or DevOps experience
* Fine-tuning, RAG over proprietary technical data, or multi-agent orchestration
* Startup experience, especially through hypergrowth

### **Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage

  + $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits
* Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)
* Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

### **Base Compensation Range**

* $150K – $400K+
* Plus Significant Equity

### **How we’re different**

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

### **About Etched**

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Compensation Range: $150K - $400K

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. ==================

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

**About the Role**
==================

As a **Fullstack Software Engineer**, you’ll build modern tools that hold up under the real-world constraints of Contested Logistics. We’re looking for someone who can build demo-ready, end-to-end flows that make resupply operations smarter, faster, and more resilient. You’ll collaborate every day with a top-notch team of engineers who value thoughtful design and practical impact. If you want to build systems that go beyond the typical cloud-based SaaS product, this could be your next chapter.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Build and deliver features that support our mission:

  + Extend our existing API layer with CRUD methods built for performance and accuracy.
  + Partner with the UX team and backend developers on rapid feature buildouts.
  + Contribute tested, production-ready code that passes our CI/CD pipeline.
  + Technical depth in at least one of the following is preferred: TypeScript, Python, SQL, Vue.js.
* Design and maintain data models and pipelines that power our Navigator platform:

  + Define and evolve relational database schemas to represent complex real-world entities.
  + Use our semantic data modeling SDK to architect efficient storage and retrieval methods.
  + Build data pipelines to ingest, transform, and distribute data across systems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teammates to improve our systems and practices:

  + Work closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to ensure features and data models align with user needs and mission outcomes.
  + Contribute to engineering best practices: from code reviews and documentation, to refining CI/CD pipelines, helping us foster a culture of excellence.
  + Help define best practices, continuously improve CI/CD workflows, while keeping DX at the forefront.

**What We’re Looking For**
==========================

* Fullstack proficiency

  + Comfortable debugging and navigating issues across the entire stack.
  + Experience building backend APIs or services in a strongly typed language.
  + Familiarity with HTTP response codes.
* Data modeling and architecture

  + Hands-on experience with relational databases – designing schemas, writing efficient queries, and ensuring data integrity and performance.
  + Experience with processing data streams and/or building or maintaining data pipelines/ETL processes to handle complex data flows between multiple systems.
* Great communicator

  + Experience working closely with diverse teams (engineering, product, design) to drive projects to completion.
  + Clear, concise communication, whether you’re designing system architecture or writing everyday documentation.
* Growth mindset

  + Always seeking to learn and stay current with industry trends and tools.

**Bonus Points**
================

* Existing security clearance, or experience with government, defense, or aerospace.
* Experience building offline-first or progressive web applications (PWAs) that operate smoothly with limited or intermittent connectivity.
* Hands-on experience with DevOps or Infrastructure-as-Code (CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.).
* Experience with cloud-based architecture such as AWS, Azure, Palantir Foundry
* Contributions to open-source projects.

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

=================

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.
